previous_statement: Compressed-unit obligation and conclusion. Put u_{P_n}=Co_{P_n}(P_n)=I_n tensor u_P. It is self-adjoint by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities and P_n^dagger=P_n from def-delta-projection. Lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action gives ||u_{P_n} dot A-A||<=C_u*e||A|| and ||A dot u_{P_n}-A||<=C_u*e||A|| at every amplification. Because P is nonvanishing, lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm gives abs(||u_P||-1)<=C_N*e. Together with the complete self-adjoint operator-space, product, associator, involution, and C*-norm obligations, def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra yields that S_P is an extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra with compressed product, inherited involution, and compressed unit u_P.
new_statement: Compressed-unit obligation and conclusion. For every n put u_{P,n}=Co_{P_n}(P_n), the unit at the n-th amplified corner (at n=1 this is u_P, and under the amplified-corner convention these are the matrix-level units induced by u_P). It is self-adjoint by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities and P_n^dagger=P_n from def-delta-projection. Lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action gives ||u_{P,n} dot A-A||<=C_u*e||A|| and ||A dot u_{P,n}-A||<=C_u*e||A||. Since ||P_n||=||P||, nonvanishing of P passes to every P_n; hence lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm gives abs(||u_{P,n}||-1)<=C_N*e at every level. Together with nodes 1.2-1.4 and the constant choices in node 1.1, all epsilon-C*-axioms hold on every matrix level with error at most C_ca*e. Therefore def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra yields that S_P is an extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra with compressed product, inherited involution, and compressed unit u_P.
